web.description:
6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- BestEx Research Group LLC, an independent provider of execution algorithms, trading technology, and trade analytics for global equities and futures, today announced the launch of Pulse AI, the world's first AI-native interface for institutional trading analytics.

[![Pulse AI by BestEx Research](https://mmx.prnewswire.com/media/MS1964789/PulseAI_BestExResearch_PressBanner.jpg?id=OA2827982&w=500)](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/bestex-research-launches-pulse-ai-the-worlds-first-ai-powered-institutional-trading-analytics-platform-302844235.html#)

Pulse AI by BestEx Research

"We built Pulse Analytics specifically to support traders, quants, and portfolio managers in their most complex decisions.

The firm's cloud-based Algorithm Management System (AMS) combines their execution algorithms with a user-friendly dashboard, transaction cost analysis, customization, and automation in the industry's first multi-asset, independent algorithmic execution platform. BestEx Research also offers sell-side firms a seamless, customizable trading solution for their clients with no coding required.
